mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% triggers a loss of investor confidence in labor market recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.4 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 4% in >60% of triggered instances, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals tightening monetary policy and weakening demand, amplifying bearish sentiment and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% while GDPC1 falls > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the interaction occurring in >60% of instances, or the IC rank is above 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) during a late-cycle expansion signals robust supply and demand alignment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 2% while HOUST rises > 1.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the interaction occurring in <50% of instances, or the IC rank is above 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation index above 2% triggers investor concerns about inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2% in >70% of triggered instances, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 150,000 triggers concerns about labor market weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 150,000 in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite PAYEMS falling below 150k in >80% of instances, or the IC rank is above 0.05 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite GDPC1 rising in >70% of instances, or the IC rank is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low unemployment (UNRATE < 3%) and historically low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 4%) during a post-shock recovery signals strong labor market and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the interaction occurring in <50% of instances, or the IC rank is above 0.05 over any 6-month window.
